directAnswer: Pope Conon reigned from 686 to 687. The son of a Thracian officer, educated in Sicily, he was chosen as a compromise between rival candidates of the Roman clergy and army, and he was elderly and ill throughout his brief pontificate.

sections.h2: A Compromise Between Clergy and Army
paras: Conon's father was an officer from the Thracesian theme, and Conon was educated in Sicily before being ordained in Rome. After John V's death, the clergy supported the archpriest Peter while the army backed a priest named Theodore, and the two sides could not agree. The Liber Pontificalis says the clergy finally turned to Conon, an old man respected for his venerable appearance and simple life, and the army accepted him.

Emperor Justinian II showed him favor, reducing taxes on papal lands in southern Italy and releasing tenants held as security for unpaid dues. Conon, however, angered the Roman clergy by appointing a deacon of Syracuse named Constantine as administrator of the Church's Sicilian estates, an appointment that led to disorder there.

Tradition holds that the Irish missionary St. Kilian came to Rome during this pontificate and received a commission from Conon to preach in Franconia. Conon was sick for most of his reign and died on 21 September 687. His death set off a disputed election that ended with the choice of Sergius I. Little else is known.

keyFacts: Son of a Thracian officer; educated in Sicily
Elected as a compromise between clergy and army candidates
Justinian II reduced taxes on papal estates during his reign
Tradition links him to the mission of St. Kilian to Franconia

faqs.question: Why was Pope Conon chosen?
faqs.answer: The Roman clergy and army backed different candidates and reached a deadlock. Conon, an elderly and widely respected priest, was put forward as a compromise and accepted by both.

faqs.question: Did Pope Conon send St. Kilian to Germany?
faqs.answer: Tradition says Kilian visited Rome under Conon and was commissioned to evangelize Franconia. The account comes from later lives of Kilian, so the details are not certain.
